translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Hirɑmu, Tirin sunɔ u Dɑfidi sɔmɔbu gɔriɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ geɑ ye bɑ sokumɔ sɛduru kɑ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kobu kɑ be bɑ rɑ kpenu dɑ̃ku, kpɑ bu nùn sinɑ kpɑɑru bɑniɑ.
Dɑfidi u tubɑ mɑ Gusunɔwɑ u win bɑndun dɑm siremɔ. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ bɑn te wɔlle suɑmɔ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Yen biru Dɑfidi u mɑɑ kurɔbu gɑbu suɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu mɑruɑ.
Berɑ Sɑmuɑ kɑ Sobɑbu kɑ Nɑtɑni kɑ Sɑlomɔɔ
kɑ Yibɑɑ kɑ Elisuɑ kɑ Elifelɛti
kɑ Nɔgɑ kɑ Nɛfɛgi kɑ Yɑfiɑ
kɑ Elisɑmɑ kɑ Beliɑdɑ kɑ sere Elifelɛti goo.
Ye Filisitibɑ bɑ nuɑ bɑ Dɑfidi gum tɑ̃re wirɔ u kuɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron sunɔ, yerɑ be kpuro bɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn wɔrim wee. Ye u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u sɑrɑ u dɑ u kɑ bu yinnɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Filisiti be, bɑ tunumɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n doo n Filisiti be wɔri? Kɑɑ mɑn bu nɔmu bɛriɑ? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo, kon nun bu nɔmu bɛriɑ.

Mɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ Bɑɑli Perɑsimuɔ. Miyɑ Dɑfidi u Filisiti be go go. Mɑ u geruɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛn yibɛrɛbɑn wuuru gĩɑ nge mɛ nim torɑ yɑ rɑ gunɑ gĩɛ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Bɑɑli Perɑsimu.
Yerɑ Filisiti be, bɑ duki suɑ bɑ ben bwɑ̃ɑrokunu deri mi. Mɑ Dɑfidi u win tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bu nu guro bu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Amɛn biru, Filisiti be, bɑ kpɑm nɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑ mi.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n mɑɑ doo n bu wɔri? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, oo. Adɑmɑ ɑ ku dɑ sɔru sɔrum mɛ. A besiro kpɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ miren sɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ nɑɑ dɑmu dɑmusu gɑsu nɔɔmɔ dɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ, ɑ yɑrimɑ. Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ nun gbiiye n kɑ ben sɑnsɑni ye wɔri.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u kuɑ nge mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U dɑ u Filisiti be go go sɑɑ Gɑbɑonin di n kɑ dɑ Gesɛɛɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yĩsiru yɑrɑ tem bɑɑmɑ kpuro sɔɔ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn dɑm wɛ̃ bwesenu kpuro sɔɔ.
